greetings.speaker: aragorn
greetings.text: Legolas! Your bow and your keen eyes are welcome at my side.
greetings.hostile: Legolas, under another banner? I hope the road that brought you there is not as dark as it looks.

greetings.speaker: aragorn
greetings.text: Gimli, son of Glóin! The axes of Erebor are welcome beside me.
greetings.hostile: Gimli. I never thought to see your axe turned toward me.

greetings.speaker: aragorn
greetings.text: Boromir of Gondor. The Captain of the White Tower is a welcome sight. Well met.
greetings.hostile: Boromir, son of Denethor. Gondor's captain stands against me? Then I grieve for it.

greetings.speaker: legolas
greetings.text: Mae govannen, Aragorn. Where you lead, my bow will follow.
greetings.hostile: Aragorn. I would rather walk beside you than face you across a field.

greetings.speaker: legolas
greetings.text: Gimli, son of Glóin. Shall we see whose people are the hardier today?
greetings.hostile: Gimli, son of Glóin, among my enemies. The Mountain and the Greenwood have quarrelled before.

greetings.speaker: legolas
greetings.text: Boromir of Gondor. Your horn carries far, and so does your courage.

greetings.speaker: gimli
greetings.text: Legolas! Light on your feet as ever, Master Elf.
greetings.hostile: Legolas. An elf under the wrong banner. I like it not.

greetings.speaker: gimli
greetings.text: Aragorn! Point me at the enemy and stand clear.
greetings.hostile: Aragorn. I would follow you into the dark, but not into this.

greetings.speaker: gimli
greetings.text: Boromir! That horn of yours is louder than any anvil under the Mountain.

greetings.speaker: boromir
greetings.text: Aragorn. Men speak of a Ranger who bears an old sword. I would see if it is sharp.
greetings.hostile: Aragorn. So it comes to swords between us. I will not pretend to be glad.

greetings.speaker: boromir
greetings.text: Legolas. I would gladly have your bow on the walls of Minas Tirith.

greetings.speaker: boromir
greetings.text: Gimli! Gondor could use a hundred of your kind on the Pelennor wall.

greetings.speaker: elrond
greetings.text: Estel, my foster-son. Imladris is always your home.
greetings.hostile: Estel. The boy I raised rides against me. What has the world done to you?
greetings.first: Estel! It has been long. The door of the Last Homely House was never shut to you.

greetings.speaker: elrond
greetings.text: Arwen, my daughter. The Evenstar of our people is home.
greetings.hostile: Arwen. My own daughter under an enemy banner. This grief I did not foresee.
greetings.first: Arwen! My heart is lighter for seeing you.

greetings.speaker: elrond
greetings.text: Celebrían, my love. Imladris is brighter for your return.
greetings.first: Celebrían! I hoped, and dared not hope, to see you again on this side of the Sea.

greetings.speaker: elrond
greetings.text: Elladan. Have you and your brother hunted orcs in the wild again?
greetings.hostile: Elladan, my son. I did not raise you to ride against me.

greetings.speaker: elrond
greetings.text: Elrohir. Is your brother near? Where one of you rides, the other follows.
greetings.hostile: Elrohir, my son. Your mother would not know you under that banner.

greetings.speaker: elrond
greetings.text: Lady Galadriel. The light of the Golden Wood is welcome in Imladris.

greetings.speaker: elrond
greetings.text: Lord Celeborn. Be welcome in my house, as I am ever welcome in yours.

greetings.speaker: elrond
greetings.text: Glorfindel. Your counsel is wanted, as it always is.

greetings.speaker: elrond
greetings.text: Erestor. What news, and what word from the borders?

greetings.speaker: elrond
greetings.text: Lindir. Is the Hall of Fire ready for tonight's songs?

greetings.speaker: elrond
greetings.text: Gildor Inglorion. The Wandering Companies are always welcome here.

greetings.speaker: elrond
greetings.text: Círdan, old friend. We have stood together since the days of Gil-galad.

greetings.speaker: elrond
greetings.text: King Thranduil. The Last Alliance bound our peoples once; I have not forgotten it.

greetings.speaker: elrond
greetings.text: Legolas, son of Thranduil. The Woodland Realm is welcome in Imladris.

greetings.speaker: elrond
greetings.text: Gimli, son of Glóin. Your father was a guest in this house with Thorin's company. You are as welcome as he.

greetings.speaker: elrond
greetings.text: Boromir of Gondor. The Steward's son is welcome in Imladris. Rest here a while.

greetings.speaker: elrond
greetings.text: Saruman. The White Council once heeded you. Speak, and I will judge your counsel.
greetings.hostile: Saruman. You were the head of our Council. Now I see what you have become.

greetings.speaker: elrond
greetings.hostile: Sauron. I was the herald of Gil-galad. I saw you overthrown once, and I do not fear you.

greetings.speaker: elrond
greetings.hostile: Lord of the Nine. Angmar fell before the Elves and the Men of the West. So will you.

greetings.speaker: arwen
greetings.text: Estel. My heart has walked every road with you.
greetings.hostile: Estel. Whatever banner you ride under, my heart does not change. But it breaks.
greetings.first: Estel! You have come back to me.

greetings.speaker: arwen
greetings.text: Father. Do not look so grave; I am here.
greetings.hostile: Father. My heart is still in Imladris, whatever banner I follow.

greetings.speaker: arwen
greetings.text: Mother. How I have missed your voice.

greetings.speaker: arwen
greetings.text: Elladan! Did you leave any orcs in the wild for others to hunt?

greetings.speaker: arwen
greetings.text: Elrohir. You have the wild in your eyes again, brother.

greetings.speaker: arwen
greetings.text: Grandmother. The Golden Wood has sent its fairest light to us.

greetings.speaker: arwen
greetings.text: Grandfather. It is good to see you beyond the borders of Lórien.

greetings.speaker: arwen
greetings.text: Glorfindel. The house feels safer with you in it.

greetings.speaker: celebrian
greetings.text: My love. Imladris is as fair as on the day we wed.

greetings.speaker: celebrian
greetings.text: Arwen, my daughter. You grow fairer with every year.

greetings.speaker: celebrian
greetings.text: Elladan. Sit with me a while, and leave the hunting to the night.

greetings.speaker: celebrian
greetings.text: Elrohir. Your eyes are too hard, my son. Rest a while.

greetings.speaker: celebrian
greetings.text: Mother. I have longed to see the Golden Wood again.

greetings.speaker: celebrian
greetings.text: Father. Lórien seems so far from here.

greetings.speaker: elladan
greetings.text: Father. The wild is quieter by a few orcs.

greetings.speaker: elladan
greetings.text: Elrohir! Ready to ride again, brother?

greetings.speaker: elladan
greetings.text: Arwen. Our sister keeps the light while we hunt in the dark.

greetings.speaker: elladan
greetings.text: Mother. We have not forgotten what was done to you.

greetings.speaker: elladan
greetings.text: Aragorn, brother! Call, and the sons of Elrond will ride with the Dúnedain.
greetings.hostile: Aragorn. We were raised as brothers. This should not be.

greetings.speaker: elladan
greetings.text: Glorfindel. Ride with us on the next hunt, if you would.

greetings.speaker: elrohir
greetings.text: Father. We came home as soon as the trail went cold.

greetings.speaker: elrohir
greetings.text: Elladan. Lead on, and I will guard your back.

greetings.speaker: elrohir
greetings.text: Arwen. You look troubled, sister. Who has grieved you?

greetings.speaker: elrohir
greetings.text: Mother. We hunt them still, every one, for what they did.

greetings.speaker: elrohir
greetings.text: Aragorn! You look hale, Chieftain of the Dúnedain.
greetings.hostile: Aragorn. I would sooner hunt orcs at your side than face you.

greetings.speaker: elrohir
greetings.text: Glorfindel. The orcs of the Ettenmoors are fewer since your last ride.

greetings.speaker: glorfindel
greetings.text: Ai na vedui, Dúnadan! Mae govannen!

greetings.speaker: glorfindel
greetings.text: Lord Elrond. The borders are watched, and the Bruinen runs high.

greetings.speaker: glorfindel
greetings.text: Lady Arwen. Imladris is the brighter for you.

greetings.speaker: glorfindel
greetings.text: Elladan. Back from the wild, and whole. Good.

greetings.speaker: glorfindel
greetings.text: Elrohir. You ride too hard, as ever.

greetings.speaker: glorfindel
greetings.text: Erestor. Have you counted every scroll in the library yet?

greetings.speaker: glorfindel
greetings.text: Lindir. Sing us something of Gondolin tonight, if you dare.

greetings.speaker: glorfindel
greetings.text: Gildor! The Wandering Companies are out late upon the roads.

greetings.speaker: glorfindel
greetings.text: Legolas of the Woodland Realm. Your people's bows are known even here.

greetings.speaker: glorfindel
greetings.text: Círdan. I came to these shores by your Havens. I have not forgotten your welcome.

greetings.speaker: glorfindel
greetings.hostile: Witch-king. Not by the hand of man will you fall. I said it at Fornost, and I say it again.

greetings.speaker: erestor
greetings.text: My lord Elrond. The council chamber is made ready.

greetings.speaker: erestor
greetings.text: Glorfindel. Your sword is restless; I can hear it from here.

greetings.speaker: erestor
greetings.text: Aragorn. Lord Elrond has been asking after you.

greetings.speaker: erestor
greetings.text: Lady Arwen. Your father will be glad you are come.

greetings.speaker: erestor
greetings.text: Lindir. Less singing and more reading, I beg you.

greetings.speaker: lindir
greetings.text: Lord Elrond. The Hall of Fire awaits, and so do the singers.

greetings.speaker: lindir
greetings.text: Aragorn! Will you hear a new song tonight, or have you heard enough of ours?

greetings.speaker: lindir
greetings.text: Lady Arwen. The songs are sweeter when you are here to hear them.

greetings.speaker: lindir
greetings.text: Erestor. A song now and then would not kill you.

greetings.speaker: lindir
greetings.text: Glorfindel. They still sing of your fight with the Balrog, you know.

greetings.speaker: gildor
greetings.text: Lord Elrond. The Wandering Companies bring you news from the West.

greetings.speaker: gildor
greetings.text: Glorfindel. The roads are dark of late. I am glad to see you on them.

greetings.speaker: gildor
greetings.text: Círdan. We are bound for the Havens, as ever, in the end.

greetings.speaker: gildor
greetings.hostile: Shadow out of the East. Elbereth Gilthoniel! Her name you fear still.

greetings.speaker: galadriel
greetings.text: My lord. The Golden Wood is at peace while you watch over it.

greetings.speaker: galadriel
greetings.text: Celebrían, my daughter. You carry the light of Lórien still.

greetings.speaker: galadriel
greetings.text: Elrond. Your house endures, as I foresaw.

greetings.speaker: galadriel
greetings.text: Arwen, child of my child. Your heart is set on a hard road, I think.

greetings.speaker: galadriel
greetings.text: Elladan. Hunting in the dark does not heal grief. Remember that.

greetings.speaker: galadriel
greetings.text: Elrohir. Your brother's grief and yours are one. Do not let it consume you.

greetings.speaker: galadriel
greetings.text: Aragorn, son of Arathorn. The Golden Wood remembers you, and Cerin Amroth remembers you better.

greetings.speaker: galadriel
greetings.text: Legolas Greenleaf. Beware of the Sea, and the cry of the gull upon the shore.

greetings.speaker: galadriel
greetings.text: Gimli, son of Glóin. Few of Durin's folk come to Lórien. You are welcome here.

greetings.speaker: galadriel
greetings.text: Boromir. Do not look away. I see what your heart seeks.

greetings.speaker: galadriel
greetings.text: Haldir. The marches are well kept. I thank you.

greetings.speaker: galadriel
greetings.text: Rúmil. Your watch on the Silverlode is faithful.

greetings.speaker: galadriel
greetings.text: Orophin. Stay close to your brothers; the borders grow dangerous.

greetings.speaker: galadriel
greetings.text: Círdan. The Shipwright and I have watched the long years pass together.

greetings.speaker: galadriel
greetings.text: Thranduil. Our woods stand against the same shadow, though you would rather we did not speak of it.

greetings.speaker: galadriel
greetings.text: Curunír. You counselled the Council to wait, and we waited. I wonder now why.
greetings.hostile: Curunír. I see you clearly now, and the White Council was wrong to trust you.

greetings.speaker: galadriel
greetings.hostile: I know your mind, Dark Lord, but you will not know mine. The door is closed.

greetings.speaker: galadriel
greetings.hostile: Shadow of Dol Guldur. The Golden Wood will not fall to you.

greetings.speaker: celeborn
greetings.text: My lady. Wherever you walk, the Wood is fair.

greetings.speaker: celeborn
greetings.text: Celebrían. You have your mother's grace, and I hope my patience.

greetings.speaker: celeborn
greetings.text: Elrond. My daughter's husband is ever welcome in Lórien.

greetings.speaker: celeborn
greetings.text: Arwen, my granddaughter. Sit by me, and tell me of Imladris.

greetings.speaker: celeborn
greetings.text: Aragorn. You are welcome in the Golden Wood, as you have been before.

greetings.speaker: celeborn
greetings.text: Legolas. The Silvan folk of Lórien greet their kin from the north.

greetings.speaker: celeborn
greetings.text: Gimli, son of Glóin. The Lady's welcome is mine also.

greetings.speaker: celeborn
greetings.text: Boromir. Gondor's sons are welcome in Lórien while they keep its peace.

greetings.speaker: celeborn
greetings.text: Haldir. Any news from the northern march?

greetings.speaker: celeborn
greetings.text: Rúmil. Keep a close watch on the eastern eaves.

greetings.speaker: celeborn
greetings.text: Orophin. Your arrows are needed on the borders.

greetings.speaker: celeborn
greetings.text: Thranduil, kinsman. Few now remember Doriath as we do.

greetings.speaker: celeborn
greetings.text: Círdan. Eldest of us all, and still at his ships. Be welcome.

greetings.speaker: celeborn
greetings.hostile: Servant of the Necromancer. Dol Guldur will not stand for ever.

greetings.speaker: haldir
greetings.text: My Lady. The borders hold.

greetings.speaker: haldir
greetings.text: My lord Celeborn. The northern march is quiet, for now.

greetings.speaker: haldir
greetings.text: Rúmil, brother. Is the eastern fence watched?

greetings.speaker: haldir
greetings.text: Orophin! Keep your bow strung, brother.

greetings.speaker: haldir
greetings.text: Aragorn. The Lady said you would come again.

greetings.speaker: haldir
greetings.text: Mae govannen, Legolas! The Silvan folk of the north are welcome among us.

greetings.speaker: haldir
greetings.text: Gimli, son of Glóin. Walk softly; the Lady's eyes are on all who enter her Wood.

greetings.speaker: haldir
greetings.text: Boromir of Gondor. Walk softly in the Golden Wood.

greetings.speaker: rumil
greetings.text: Haldir. The eastern eaves are quiet.

greetings.speaker: rumil
greetings.text: Orophin. Your turn at the watch, brother.

greetings.speaker: rumil
greetings.text: My Lady. The Silverlode is watched.

greetings.speaker: rumil
greetings.text: My lord. All is quiet along the river.

greetings.speaker: rumil
greetings.text: Legolas. Our kin of the Greenwood are always welcome.

greetings.speaker: orophin
greetings.text: Haldir. Shall I run to the Lady with word, as before?

greetings.speaker: orophin
greetings.text: Rúmil. Sleep a while; I will take the watch.

greetings.speaker: orophin
greetings.text: My Lady. The borders are kept.

greetings.speaker: orophin
greetings.text: My lord. Orc tracks near the eaves again. We will follow them.

greetings.speaker: orophin
greetings.text: Legolas! It is not often we see the folk of the Greenwood this far south.

greetings.speaker: cirdan
greetings.text: Elrond. I knew you when you were the herald of Gil-galad. Now you are the wisest of us.

greetings.speaker: cirdan
greetings.text: Lady Galadriel. The Havens keep a ship for you, when you choose.

greetings.speaker: cirdan
greetings.text: Celeborn. The Havens are open to you and yours.

greetings.speaker: cirdan
greetings.text: Gildor. Have you come to the Havens to stay at last?

greetings.speaker: cirdan
greetings.text: Glorfindel. I remember the day your ship came out of the West.

greetings.speaker: cirdan
greetings.text: Curunír. You never forgave me for the ring I gave the Grey Pilgrim.
greetings.hostile: Curunír. I saw your envy long ago. I see where it has led you.

greetings.speaker: cirdan
greetings.hostile: Sauron. I stood with Gil-galad when you fell. The Havens do not forget.

greetings.speaker: cirdan
greetings.hostile: Witch-king. Lindon and Gondor broke Angmar once. We can do it again.

greetings.speaker: thranduil
greetings.text: My son. The Greenwood has missed your bow.
greetings.hostile: My son, against me? I would not have believed it.
greetings.first: Legolas! Home at last. Sit, and tell me what the world beyond the trees has done to you.

greetings.speaker: thranduil
greetings.text: Galion. Mind the cellars. I remember what happened the last time you minded them.

greetings.speaker: thranduil
greetings.text: Son of Glóin. I remember your father; he was a guest in my halls, though not by his own wish.
greetings.hostile: Son of Glóin, under an enemy banner. Your father fared better in my dungeons.

greetings.speaker: thranduil
greetings.text: Aragorn, son of Arathorn. The Rangers of the North are seldom seen under my trees. Be welcome.

greetings.speaker: thranduil
greetings.text: Elrond. We both lost a king in the Last Alliance: you yours, and I my father.

greetings.speaker: thranduil
greetings.text: Lady Galadriel. The Greenwood and the Golden Wood face the same shadow.

greetings.speaker: thranduil
greetings.text: Lord Celeborn. The Golden Wood and the Greenwood are the last of the old realms.

greetings.speaker: thranduil
greetings.text: Dáin Ironfoot. You came swiftly from the Iron Hills once, when it mattered. I have not forgotten.

greetings.speaker: thranduil
greetings.text: King Brand. The grandson of Bard is always welcome in the Woodland Realm.

greetings.speaker: thranduil
greetings.text: Grimbeorn, son of Beorn. The Greenwood is glad of your watch on the river.

greetings.speaker: thranduil
greetings.hostile: Sauron. My father died before your gate. I have not forgotten.

greetings.speaker: thranduil
greetings.hostile: Servant of Dol Guldur. Your shadow will not darken my woods for ever.

greetings.speaker: galion
greetings.text: My king. The wine of Dorwinion is laid in, and the cellars are full.

greetings.speaker: galion
greetings.text: Prince Legolas! Shall I open a cask of the good red from Dorwinion?

greetings.speaker: legolas
greetings.text: Father. I bring news from beyond the trees, and little of it good.
greetings.hostile: Father. I never thought to stand against the Woodland Realm.

greetings.speaker: legolas
greetings.text: Galion. Not too much of the red tonight, I beg you.

greetings.speaker: legolas
greetings.text: Lady Galadriel. The light of the Golden Wood is never far from my thoughts.

greetings.speaker: legolas
greetings.text: Lord Celeborn. The Silvan folk of the north greet you.

greetings.speaker: legolas
greetings.text: Haldir! Mae govannen. Your watch is as sharp as ever.

greetings.speaker: legolas
greetings.text: Rúmil. The eaves of Lórien are fair in any season.

greetings.speaker: legolas
greetings.text: Orophin. Keep your arrows for the orcs, not for wandering elves.

greetings.speaker: legolas
greetings.text: Lord Elrond. My father sends his greeting to Imladris.

greetings.speaker: legolas
greetings.text: Glorfindel. It is an honour to stand beside the slayer of the Balrog.

greetings.speaker: legolas
greetings.text: Prince Imrahil. There is elven blood in your house. I see it in your face.

greetings.speaker: legolas
greetings.text: Théoden King. Your horses are swift, and your people proud.

greetings.speaker: legolas
greetings.text: Éomer. Your riders are fleet, but my eyes are faster.

greetings.speaker: legolas
greetings.hostile: Saruman. Your voice is fair, but your deeds are not.

greetings.speaker: grimbeorn
greetings.text: Elvenking. My folk keep the High Pass and the Ford. No orc crosses while we watch.

greetings.speaker: dain
greetings.text: Gimli, son of Glóin! The Mountain is glad of you. What news from the West?
greetings.hostile: Gimli, Glóin's son, under an enemy banner. Your father would weep to see it.
greetings.first: Gimli! Back under the Mountain at last. Come, your king would hear your tale.

greetings.speaker: dain
greetings.text: Thorin, my son. Keep your axe sharp; the East is stirring.
greetings.hostile: Thorin. My own son against me? The Mountain will not forgive this.

greetings.speaker: dain
greetings.text: King Brand! Dale and the Mountain stand together, as in your grandsire's day.
greetings.hostile: Brand. Dale against the Mountain? Bard the Bowman would be ashamed.

greetings.speaker: dain
greetings.text: Bard, son of Brand. You bear the name of your father's grandsire. I hope you have his aim too.

greetings.speaker: dain
greetings.text: Elvenking. We stood together before the Mountain once. I have not forgotten it.

greetings.speaker: thorin_stonehelm
greetings.text: Father. The gates are watched and the halls are quiet.
greetings.hostile: Father. I never wished to raise my axe against you.

greetings.speaker: thorin_stonehelm
greetings.text: Gimli! The Mountain is the poorer when you wander so far.

greetings.speaker: thorin_stonehelm
greetings.text: King Brand. Erebor's gates are open to the men of Dale.

greetings.speaker: thorin_stonehelm
greetings.text: Bard! When the Easterlings come, you will find my axe beside your bow.

greetings.speaker: gimli
greetings.text: My king! Erebor stands, and Durin's folk with it, I hope.
greetings.hostile: King Dáin. It shames me to stand against the Mountain.
greetings.first: My king! I am home at last, and I have tales to tell.

greetings.speaker: gimli
greetings.text: Thorin, son of Dáin. You will make a fine king one day.

greetings.speaker: gimli
greetings.text: King Thranduil. My father still speaks of your dungeons, and not kindly.

greetings.speaker: gimli
greetings.text: Lady of the Wood. You are fairer than all the jewels beneath the earth.

greetings.speaker: gimli
greetings.text: Lord Celeborn. Your Wood is fairer than any dwarf would believe.

greetings.speaker: gimli
greetings.text: Haldir. Your trees are tall, but I will not lose my way among them.

greetings.speaker: gimli
greetings.text: Lord Elrond. My father Glóin sends his regards from the Mountain.

greetings.speaker: gimli
greetings.text: King Brand! I hear the toy market of Dale is still the finest in the North.

greetings.speaker: gimli
greetings.text: Théoden King. Your halls are fair, though a dwarf would put more stone in them.

greetings.speaker: gimli
greetings.text: Éomer of the Mark! Your horses are fine beasts, for those who like such things.

greetings.speaker: gimli
greetings.hostile: Saruman! The words of this wizard stand on their heads.

greetings.speaker: brand
greetings.text: King Dáin. While the Mountain holds, Dale will not fall.
greetings.hostile: Dáin. I never thought to see Dale and the Mountain at odds.

greetings.speaker: brand
greetings.text: Bard, my son. Hold the walls of Dale while I ride.

greetings.speaker: brand
greetings.text: Thorin Stonehelm. Dale's bowmen will be on the walls when the Mountain needs them.

greetings.speaker: brand
greetings.text: King Thranduil. The Elves were my grandsire's friends. Be mine also.

greetings.speaker: brand
greetings.text: Gimli, Glóin's son! Dale has missed your father's stories.

greetings.speaker: bard
greetings.text: Father. Dale is ready.

greetings.speaker: bard
greetings.text: King Dáin. My bow is at the Mountain's call.

greetings.speaker: bard
greetings.text: Thorin! The bells of Dale ring for the prince under the Mountain.

greetings.speaker: denethor
greetings.text: My son. You are come back to me, and the City is the stronger for it.
greetings.hostile: Boromir. My son and heir, against the White Tower? This I will not bear.
greetings.first: Boromir! At last. The White Tower has missed its captain.

greetings.speaker: denethor
greetings.text: Faramir. Well, you are here. Let us hope your counsel is wiser than it was.
greetings.hostile: Faramir. I always feared you would not stand where you should.

greetings.speaker: denethor
greetings.text: Imrahil. Dol Amroth's knights are welcome, the more so now.

greetings.speaker: denethor
greetings.text: So the North sends another captain to my door. I know that look, Thorongil.
greetings.hostile: Heir of Isildur, you name yourself. I will not bow to a ragged Ranger out of the North.

greetings.speaker: denethor
greetings.text: King Théoden. Gondor remembers the oath of Eorl.

greetings.speaker: denethor
greetings.text: Hirgon. Ride swiftly, and bring me true news.

greetings.speaker: denethor
greetings.text: Forlong. Lossarnach sends its men. That is well.

greetings.speaker: denethor
greetings.text: Hirluin the Fair. The men of the Green Hills are welcome in the City.

greetings.speaker: denethor
greetings.text: Angbor of Lamedon. Your men stand firm, I am told. See that they do.

greetings.speaker: denethor
greetings.text: Duinhir of Morthond. Your archers are needed on the walls.

greetings.speaker: denethor
greetings.hostile: Sauron. You will not have the City while a Steward lives.

greetings.speaker: boromir
greetings.text: Father. The White Tower stands, and so do I.
greetings.hostile: Father. I never thought to face the White Tower as its enemy.

greetings.speaker: boromir
greetings.text: Little brother! Come, tell me how Ithilien fares.
greetings.hostile: Faramir, under another's banner? I will not believe it of you.

greetings.speaker: boromir
greetings.text: Uncle Imrahil! The Swan Knights and I ride as one, as ever.

greetings.speaker: boromir
greetings.text: Cousin Elphir. You grow more like your father every year.

greetings.speaker: boromir
greetings.text: Erchirion! Still the boldest rider in Dol Amroth, cousin?

greetings.speaker: boromir
greetings.text: Amrothos, cousin. Mind you keep up with your brothers.

greetings.speaker: boromir
greetings.text: Cousin Lothíriel. Dol Amroth's fairest daughter. Is the sea kind to you?

greetings.speaker: boromir
greetings.text: Forlong the Fat! Is there enough mutton in Lossarnach to keep you hale?

greetings.speaker: boromir
greetings.text: Hirluin! The Green Hills send their best, I see.

greetings.speaker: boromir
greetings.text: Angbor the Fearless. I am glad you are on our side.

greetings.speaker: boromir
greetings.text: Duinhir. The bowmen of Morthond are worth a host.

greetings.speaker: boromir
greetings.text: Théoden King. The Riders of the Mark are the best friends Gondor has.

greetings.speaker: boromir
greetings.text: Éomer! Riders of Rohan at my side would gladden any captain.

greetings.speaker: boromir
greetings.text: Lord Elrond. Gondor has long heard of the wisdom of Imladris.

greetings.speaker: boromir
greetings.text: Lady of the Wood. Men of Gondor say few come out of your land unchanged.

greetings.speaker: faramir
greetings.text: Father. I have come to report, as you bade me.
greetings.hostile: Father. I never wished to stand against you, whatever you thought of me.

greetings.speaker: faramir
greetings.text: Boromir. The City is glad of you, and I gladdest of all.
greetings.hostile: Brother. I never thought to face you across a field.

greetings.speaker: faramir
greetings.text: Uncle. The banner of the Swan is a welcome sight.

greetings.speaker: faramir
greetings.text: Elphir, cousin. How fares Dol Amroth?

greetings.speaker: faramir
greetings.text: Erchirion. You look as though you have ridden hard, cousin.

greetings.speaker: faramir
greetings.text: Amrothos, cousin. Has your father let you lead the knights yet?

greetings.speaker: faramir
greetings.text: Lothíriel, cousin. You bring the sea air with you.

greetings.speaker: imrahil
greetings.text: Lord Steward. The Swan rides at your call.

greetings.speaker: imrahil
greetings.text: Boromir, my sister's son! Gondor's sword is welcome in Dol Amroth.
greetings.hostile: Boromir. Finduilas's son against me? My sister would grieve to see it.

greetings.speaker: imrahil
greetings.text: Faramir, my sister's son. You have Finduilas's eyes.
greetings.hostile: Faramir. Of all who might stand against me, I least expected you.

greetings.speaker: imrahil
greetings.text: Elphir, my son and heir. The Swan Knights look well under you.

greetings.speaker: imrahil
greetings.text: Erchirion. Ride with me today, my son.

greetings.speaker: imrahil
greetings.text: Amrothos, my son. Ride close to your brothers today.

greetings.speaker: imrahil
greetings.text: Lothíriel, my daughter. The sea is in your eyes today.

greetings.speaker: imrahil
greetings.text: Legolas of the Elves. It is said that one of your people, Mithrellas, is a mother of my house.

greetings.speaker: imrahil
greetings.text: Forlong. Lossarnach and Dol Amroth together again.

greetings.speaker: imrahil
greetings.text: Hirluin. The Green Hills are good neighbours to Dol Amroth.

greetings.speaker: imrahil
greetings.text: Angbor. Lamedon's men are welcome beside mine.

greetings.speaker: imrahil
greetings.text: Duinhir. Morthond's bows and Dol Amroth's lances. A good match.

greetings.speaker: elphir
greetings.text: Father. Dol Amroth is watched, as you commanded.

greetings.speaker: elphir
greetings.text: Erchirion. Keep to the line this time, brother.

greetings.speaker: elphir
greetings.text: Amrothos. Stay close, little brother.

greetings.speaker: elphir
greetings.text: Lothíriel. Father will want to see you.

greetings.speaker: elphir
greetings.text: Cousin Boromir. Dol Amroth rides with the Captain-General.

greetings.speaker: elphir
greetings.text: Faramir, cousin. Is Ithilien still yours?

greetings.speaker: erchirion
greetings.text: Father! The knights are mustered.

greetings.speaker: erchirion
greetings.text: Elphir. Lead, brother, and I will follow.

greetings.speaker: erchirion
greetings.text: Amrothos! Race you to the shore.

greetings.speaker: erchirion
greetings.text: Lothíriel, sister. You are a sight for tired eyes.

greetings.speaker: erchirion
greetings.text: Boromir! The best rider in Gondor, after me.

greetings.speaker: erchirion
greetings.text: Faramir. You look tired, cousin. The Rangers work you too hard.

greetings.speaker: amrothos
greetings.text: Father. I am ready to ride.

greetings.speaker: amrothos
greetings.text: Elphir. I can keep up, I promise.

greetings.speaker: amrothos
greetings.text: Erchirion. I will beat you to the shore one day.

greetings.speaker: amrothos
greetings.text: Lothíriel! Will you walk on the shore with me?

greetings.speaker: amrothos
greetings.text: Boromir! Ride with us today, and show Dol Amroth how Gondor fights.

greetings.speaker: amrothos
greetings.text: Faramir, cousin! Tell me of Ithilien and the Rangers.

greetings.speaker: lothiriel
greetings.text: Father. Welcome home.

greetings.speaker: lothiriel
greetings.text: Elphir. Be careful, brother.

greetings.speaker: lothiriel
greetings.text: Erchirion. Try not to fall off your horse this time.

greetings.speaker: lothiriel
greetings.text: Amrothos, brother. Mind Erchirion does not lead you into trouble again.

greetings.speaker: lothiriel
greetings.text: Cousin Boromir. The City's captain honours Dol Amroth.

greetings.speaker: lothiriel
greetings.text: Cousin Faramir. You always bring the best stories.

greetings.speaker: forlong
greetings.text: My lord Steward. Lossarnach has come, as it always has.

greetings.speaker: forlong
greetings.text: Captain Boromir! Lossarnach's axes are at your service.

greetings.speaker: forlong
greetings.text: Prince Imrahil. A sight to cheer an old man.

greetings.speaker: hirluin
greetings.text: Lord Steward. Pinnath Gelin answers the call of the City.

greetings.speaker: hirluin
greetings.text: Boromir. Pinnath Gelin rides with you.

greetings.speaker: hirluin
greetings.text: Prince Imrahil. The Green Hills ride beside the Swan.

greetings.speaker: angbor
greetings.text: Lord Steward. Lamedon holds.

greetings.speaker: angbor
greetings.text: Boromir. Lamedon is ready.

greetings.speaker: angbor
greetings.text: Prince Imrahil. Lamedon and Dol Amroth together.

greetings.speaker: duinhir
greetings.text: Lord Steward. The Blackroot Vale sends its archers.

greetings.speaker: duinhir
greetings.text: Boromir. Morthond's bows are yours.

greetings.speaker: duinhir
greetings.text: Duilin, my son. Keep your bowmen close.

greetings.speaker: duinhir
greetings.text: Derufin, my son. Stay near your brother.

greetings.speaker: duinhir
greetings.text: Prince Imrahil. Morthond stands with Dol Amroth.

greetings.speaker: duilin
greetings.text: Father. The Blackroot archers are ready.

greetings.speaker: duilin
greetings.text: Derufin, brother. Stay at my side.

greetings.speaker: derufin
greetings.text: Father. We will make Morthond proud.

greetings.speaker: derufin
greetings.text: Duilin! Where you go, brother, I go.

greetings.speaker: hirgon
greetings.text: My lord Steward. Your errands are carried, and the beacons watched.

greetings.speaker: hirgon
greetings.text: Lord King. I bring word from the Steward of Gondor.

greetings.speaker: hirgon
greetings.text: Lord Boromir. The City's errand-riders are at your call.

greetings.speaker: theoden
greetings.text: Éomer, my sister-son! The Riddermark is safer for your spear.
greetings.hostile: Éomer. My own sister-son under another banner. I did not raise you for this.
greetings.first: Éomer! Come here, sister-son. It has been too long.

greetings.speaker: theoden
greetings.text: Éowyn, my sister-daughter. You are the light of this hall.
greetings.hostile: Éowyn. I would sooner lose my crown than see you against me.
greetings.first: Éowyn! The hall has been dark without you, child.

greetings.speaker: theoden
greetings.text: Théodred, my son. Is the Westfold quiet?
greetings.hostile: Théodred. My own son. Have I failed you so badly?

greetings.speaker: theoden
greetings.text: Elfhild, my queen. The hall is warmer for you.

greetings.speaker: theoden
greetings.text: Éomund, brother. Guard the east marches well; the orcs grow bold.

greetings.speaker: theoden
greetings.text: Théodwyn, sister. Your children grow into the strength of the Mark.

greetings.speaker: theoden
greetings.text: Erkenbrand of Westfold. Is the Deeping Wall in good repair?

greetings.speaker: theoden
greetings.text: Grimbold. The Westfold needs its hardest men. I am glad you are one.

greetings.speaker: theoden
greetings.text: Dúnhere of Harrowdale. Keep the road to Dunharrow open.

greetings.speaker: theoden
greetings.text: Gríma. Your counsel is ever ready, and ever dark.
greetings.hostile: Wormtongue! Crawl back to your master in Isengard.

greetings.speaker: theoden
greetings.text: Aragorn, son of Arathorn. The Mark has need of men like you.

greetings.speaker: theoden
greetings.text: Legolas of the Woodland Realm. Few of your folk ride through the Mark.

greetings.speaker: theoden
greetings.text: Gimli, son of Glóin. The Mark has few guests from the Mountain. Be welcome.

greetings.speaker: theoden
greetings.text: Boromir of Gondor. The Mark remembers the friendship of the Stewards.

greetings.speaker: theoden
greetings.text: Lord Denethor. While Rohan rides, Gondor does not stand alone.

greetings.speaker: theoden
greetings.text: Hirgon. What does the Steward ask of the Mark?

greetings.speaker: theoden
greetings.text: Saruman. You were a friend to the Mark once. I wonder if you still are.
greetings.hostile: Saruman. We will have peace when you and all your works have perished.

greetings.speaker: eomer
greetings.text: Uncle. The Eastfold is watched, and the riders wait on your word.
greetings.hostile: Uncle. I never thought to ride against you.

greetings.speaker: eomer
greetings.text: Sister! Are you well? The hall has been cold of late.
greetings.hostile: Éowyn. Whatever banner you ride under, you are still my sister.

greetings.speaker: eomer
greetings.text: Cousin! Is the Westfold holding?

greetings.speaker: eomer
greetings.text: Father. The riders of the Eastfold are ready.

greetings.speaker: eomer
greetings.text: Mother. Rest. I will see to everything.

greetings.speaker: eomer
greetings.text: Erkenbrand. Westfold's lord is a welcome sight.

greetings.speaker: eomer
greetings.text: Grimbold! Ride with me, and we will clear the Fords.

greetings.speaker: eomer
greetings.text: Wormtongue. Keep your counsel, and keep your eyes from my sister.
greetings.hostile: Wormtongue! There is no king's hall here for you to hide in.

greetings.speaker: eomer
greetings.text: Aragorn! The Mark is open to a friend of Gondor.

greetings.speaker: eomer
greetings.text: Legolas! Your eyes are worth a dozen scouts to me.

greetings.speaker: eomer
greetings.text: Gimli, Glóin's son! Axes from the Mountain are welcome in the Mark.

greetings.speaker: eomer
greetings.text: Boromir! Gondor's captain is welcome in the Mark.

greetings.speaker: eomer
greetings.hostile: Orc of the White Hand. You are far from your master.

greetings.speaker: eomer
greetings.hostile: Saruman. The Mark remembers every farm you burned.

greetings.speaker: eowyn
greetings.text: My lord uncle. I have kept the hall while you rode.
greetings.hostile: Uncle. It grieves me to face the king who raised me.

greetings.speaker: eowyn
greetings.text: Brother. You ride too far and too often.
greetings.hostile: Éomer. Brother, what has come between us?

greetings.speaker: eowyn
greetings.text: Théodred. Bring your riders home whole.

greetings.speaker: eowyn
greetings.text: Father. Come home safe this time.

greetings.speaker: eowyn
greetings.text: Mother. Do not grieve so. We are here.

greetings.speaker: eowyn
greetings.text: Lord Aragorn. Will you not stay a while in Edoras?

greetings.speaker: eowyn
greetings.text: Gríma. Keep your distance, and your eyes to yourself.
greetings.hostile: Wormtongue. I would gladly see you gone from the Mark for ever.

greetings.speaker: eowyn
greetings.text: Dúnhere. Harrowdale has always been loyal. I am grateful.

greetings.speaker: eowyn
greetings.hostile: Begone, foul dwimmerlaik, lord of carrion! You will not touch my kin.

greetings.speaker: theodred
greetings.text: Father. The Fords of Isen hold, for now.
greetings.hostile: Father. I would give much not to stand here against you.

greetings.speaker: theodred
greetings.text: Éomer. Good. With you at the Eastfold, I sleep easier at the Fords.

greetings.speaker: theodred
greetings.text: Cousin Éowyn. You look as though you would ride with us.

greetings.speaker: theodred
greetings.text: Grimbold. Hold the eastern bank of the Isen for me.

greetings.speaker: theodred
greetings.text: Erkenbrand. The Westfold is in good hands.

greetings.speaker: theodred
greetings.text: Gríma. My father listens to you too much.
greetings.hostile: Wormtongue. I have never trusted you.

greetings.speaker: elfhild
greetings.text: My lord. Come, sit by the fire, and set the crown aside a while.

greetings.speaker: eomund
greetings.text: Lord Théoden. The east marches are watched, as I swore.

greetings.speaker: eomund
greetings.text: Éomer, my son. You sit a horse better than I did at your age.

greetings.speaker: eomund
greetings.text: Éowyn. My little shieldmaiden.

greetings.speaker: eomund
greetings.text: Théodwyn, my love. I am home.

greetings.speaker: theodwyn
greetings.text: Brother. If ever I cannot, watch over Éomer and Éowyn.

greetings.speaker: theodwyn
greetings.text: Éomer, my son. You have your father's fire.

greetings.speaker: theodwyn
greetings.text: Éowyn, daughter. Hold your head high, as befits the house of Eorl.

greetings.speaker: theodwyn
greetings.text: Éomund. Every time you ride east, I watch the road until you return.

greetings.speaker: erkenbrand
greetings.text: Lord King. The Westfold and the Hornburg are yours to command.

greetings.speaker: erkenbrand
greetings.text: Éomer. The Eastfold and the Westfold, riding together.

greetings.speaker: erkenbrand
greetings.text: Grimbold. Your riders and mine will hold the west.

greetings.speaker: erkenbrand
greetings.text: Prince Théodred. The Westfold is ready for your call.

greetings.speaker: grimbold
greetings.text: My king. Grimslade's riders wait on your word.

greetings.speaker: grimbold
greetings.text: Prince Théodred. My riders stand with you at the Fords.

greetings.speaker: grimbold
greetings.text: Erkenbrand. Westfold holds.

greetings.speaker: grimbold
greetings.text: Éomer. I will ride wherever you lead.

greetings.speaker: dunhere
greetings.text: Lord King. Harrowdale and Dunharrow are yours.

greetings.speaker: dunhere
greetings.text: Lady Éowyn. Harrowdale will shelter your people, if it comes to that.

greetings.speaker: grima
greetings.text: My lord king. You look weary. Sit, and let your servant counsel you.
greetings.hostile: Théoden, the dotard of Edoras. My master sends no greeting.

greetings.speaker: grima
greetings.text: Éomer, son of Éomund. Still rash, I see. The king will hear of it.

greetings.speaker: grima
greetings.text: Lady Éowyn. You are pale. These cold halls do not suit you.

greetings.speaker: grima
greetings.text: Prince Théodred. Ride carefully at the Fords.

greetings.speaker: grima
greetings.text: Master. Edoras sleeps, and the king with it.

greetings.speaker: saruman
greetings.text: Gríma, my faithful servant. What news from Edoras?

greetings.speaker: saruman
greetings.text: Uglúk. Bring me what I seek, and bring it whole.

greetings.speaker: saruman
greetings.text: Théoden, my friend. Why should we quarrel?
greetings.hostile: Théoden, lord of a barn where brigands drink in the reek. You will kneel yet.

greetings.speaker: saruman
greetings.text: Éomer, son of Éomund. Rash and young. Your uncle would do well to leash you.

greetings.speaker: saruman
greetings.text: Aragorn, son of Arathorn. Come, we need not be enemies.
greetings.hostile: Aragorn. A Ranger with a borrowed crown in his dreams.

greetings.speaker: saruman
greetings.hostile: Gimli, son of Glóin. Dwarves should keep to their holes.

greetings.speaker: saruman
greetings.text: Lady Galadriel. The Council misses your wisdom, as do I.
greetings.hostile: Galadriel. Your Wood will burn like all the rest.

greetings.speaker: saruman
greetings.text: Elrond. The Council should heed me, as it once did.
greetings.hostile: Elrond. Your little valley cannot hide you for ever.

greetings.speaker: saruman
greetings.text: Círdan. The Havens are far from Orthanc, yet little that passes there escapes me.

greetings.speaker: saruman
greetings.text: Sauron. We are allies, you and I. For now.
greetings.hostile: Sauron. Orthanc will never bow to Barad-dûr.

greetings.speaker: ugluk
greetings.text: Master! The fighting Uruk-hai of the White Hand are ready.

greetings.speaker: ugluk
greetings.hostile: Horse-boy! The White Hand will have your horses for supper.

greetings.speaker: sauron
greetings.text: My Lieutenant. The North is yours to break.

greetings.speaker: sauron
greetings.text: Khamûl. Dol Guldur answers to you, and you to me.

greetings.speaker: sauron
greetings.text: My Mouth. Speak my words, and only mine.

greetings.speaker: sauron
greetings.text: Gothmog. The hosts of Morgul are yours to drive.

greetings.speaker: sauron
greetings.text: Shagrat. Cirith Ungol is yours to hold. Fail me, and you will wish for the spider.

greetings.speaker: sauron
greetings.text: Gorbag. Keep the gate of Minas Morgul shut, and your quarrels quiet.

greetings.speaker: sauron
greetings.text: Saruman. My servant at Orthanc, though you dream otherwise.
greetings.hostile: Saruman. The traitor of Orthanc will learn who is master.

greetings.speaker: sauron
greetings.hostile: Heir of Isildur. Your line ends with you.

greetings.speaker: sauron
greetings.hostile: Steward of Gondor. You have looked into the Stone, and I have looked back.

greetings.speaker: sauron
greetings.hostile: Lady of the Wood. Your ring cannot hide you from me for ever.

greetings.speaker: sauron
greetings.hostile: Herald of Gil-galad. Your king is dust, and you will follow him.

greetings.speaker: sauron
greetings.hostile: Shipwright. Your Havens will not save you.

greetings.speaker: sauron
greetings.hostile: Son of Oropher. Your father fell on the Dagorlad. You will fall behind your trees.

greetings.speaker: mouth_of_sauron
greetings.text: Great Lord. Your Mouth awaits your words.

greetings.speaker: mouth_of_sauron
greetings.text: Lord of the Nazgûl. The Tower sends its regard.

greetings.speaker: mouth_of_sauron
greetings.hostile: So you are the one who claims the line of Isildur. Bold, for a Ranger.

greetings.speaker: gothmog
greetings.text: Great Eye. The legions of Morgul march at your word.

greetings.speaker: gothmog
greetings.text: Lord of the Nine. Morgul's hosts await your command.

greetings.speaker: gothmog
greetings.text: Gorbag. Keep your rabble in order at the Morgul gate.

greetings.speaker: gothmog
greetings.text: Shagrat. Hold the pass. Nothing comes through Cirith Ungol unseen.

greetings.speaker: gorbag
greetings.text: Great Master. The gate of Morgul is shut tight.

greetings.speaker: gorbag
greetings.text: My lord. The garrison of Minas Morgul is ready.

greetings.speaker: gorbag
greetings.text: Lieutenant. My lads are ready, more or less.

greetings.speaker: gorbag
greetings.text: Shagrat, you old rat. Still sitting on that tower of yours?

greetings.speaker: shagrat
greetings.text: Master. Cirith Ungol is held, as Lugbúrz commands.

greetings.speaker: shagrat
greetings.text: Lord. The tower is yours.

greetings.speaker: shagrat
greetings.text: Lieutenant. The pass is watched.

greetings.speaker: shagrat
greetings.text: Gorbag. Keep your Morgul scum off my stairs.
